sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Standby to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Response call from a member of the public reporting a male individual fully naked walking along Anzac Avenue towards Fort Street. Leaving HQ and patrolling down Queen Street in search of the POI.
Arrived at the bottom of Fort Street; stopped by Char Grill, who had seen the male. Retrieved a photo taken by the store owner — POI last seen heading towards Fort Lane. (Photo on file.)

After repeatedly scanning the area and patrolling every street, unable to locate the POI. Called the reporting individual back, but his whereabouts could not be established. Notified the patrol community group chat and advised all CBD security guards to be on alert for this suspect.
Back at HQ, standby to recharge the Ops Phone and await response calls.
Continuing patrols, maintaining presence along Queen Street.
Response call from The Right Track, Fort Street, reporting two street vagrants causing a disturbance.
Arrived at The Right Track; POIs had already left. Store manager requested a verbal trespass for both. Standby to show presence and await response calls.
Staff advised that a well-known female who causes disturbances is no longer allowed access to The Right Track. The female was seen walking in and was safely escorted back out.

The two male individuals reported earlier returned and tried to enter but were stopped and advised they are no longer allowed access. The male in red was upset at his friend in blue; advised we cannot help with the actions they choose to commit.
Follow-up check at McDonald's Britomart — a staff member reported a knife had been pulled on her by some minors. Area now clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full walkthrough scoping for any issues.
Wednesday food truck set up again at the back of the entrance way.
A member of the public approached for assistance finding a location; leading them to 220 Queen Street.
Arrived at HQ; directed the individual to Level 7 for a job interview. Taking morning interval while recharging the Ops Phone due to low battery.
Ops Phone still low due to a faulty charger. Continuing standby while on alert for incidents and response calls.
Welfare check at Liquor City, reassuring them we are here to assist with any further trouble.
Welfare check completed along Elliott Street, all clear.
Welfare check completed within Mid City shopping centre stores and businesses, all clear. Patrolling back to HQ to meet with managers.
Continuing patrols, leaving HQ to show presence.
Patrolling through Lorne Street, welfare checks on all stores and businesses.
Arrived at the corner intersection of Queen and Wellesley Street, welfare checks on all stores and businesses, all clear.
Commencing welfare check within Elliott Stables.
Leaving Elliott Stables with no issues reported; patrolling through Elliott Street maintaining strong presence.
Response call from management reporting an incident at the corner of Queen and Darby Street, with two ambulances parked up.
Arrived at the location; unclear what is happening but standing by to show strong presence. (Two ambulances on scene.)
Arrived at HQ, taking lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

Response call from McDonald's Britomart reporting two Caucasian males in their early 20s who entered the bathroom and smoked cannabis inside; the stench is heavily affecting customers. Last seen heading up Queen Street; awaiting a photo description. A verbal trespass will be issued once located.
Unsuccessful search; will notify the Afternoon Shift of the incident.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart reporting two street vagrants consuming alcohol in front of the store; assistance requested to move them along.
Equipment handover: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. Ops Phone at 19%.
Notes: ensure presence and welfare checks at Liquor City; collect all physical surveys from stores.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding two males consuming alcohol outside; assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; advised the male consuming alcohol not to drink in public. He complied and made it discreet.
Commencing a full sweep of TK Square, welfare checks at ICBC, Kowhai Cafe, Downtown Kebab, Commercial Bay shopping centre.
Full sweep of TK Square complete, no issues reported. Standing by for any issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby, no issues or problematic vagrants.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street / Victoria Street West, welfare checks, all clear:
Response call from Roma Blooms regarding a male vagrant sitting outside; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at Roma Blooms; advised the male vagrant to move along. He is compliant; standing by as he is in a wheelchair.
Male vagrant successfully moved along. (Video on file.)
Kiwi Gifts reported they experience occasional theft but do not call because the items stolen are small; advised them to call so we can document on Auror, as offenders may also target other stores.
Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone due to low battery.
Arrived at HQ to charge Ops Phone, remaining vigilant for response calls.
Response call from Pop Mart Queen Street regarding a male who stole from the store, last seen heading up Hobson Street; a staff member is currently following him. (Photo on file.)

Linked up with the Pop Mart staff member outside the Huawei building on Albert Street; he had lost the offender near the Huawei building. Sweeping the area — Elliott Street, Crowne Plaza, Huawei building.
No sign of the male from Pop Mart. Advised the staff member we will keep watch while on patrol and retrieve stolen goods if found.
Commencing patrols and collecting physical surveys from stores.
Collecting surveys from stores on Albert Street and Victoria Street West.
Surveys received from stores on Albert Street and Victoria Street West.
Check-in at City Liquor, no issues provided.
Maintaining presence on Queen Street, watching for any issues or vagrants.
Arrived outside Avachi, welfare checks on stores:
Welfare checks on the above complete, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining presence and watching for issues or vagrants.
No issues in the area; heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Arrived outside McDonald's Queen Street, welfare check, no issues reported.
Arrived at Aotea Square, welfare checks (nothing reported), then full sweep watching for issues or vagrants:
Aotea Square sweep complete, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining presence.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive check-in, welfare checks, all clear:
Arrived at Elliott Stables, welfare checks, all clear. Standing by at Elliott Stables.
Arrived at Lorne Street, commencing a full sweep with welfare checks on stores.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street East / Lorne Street, welfare checks and full sweep complete, no issues to report.
Arrived at Freyberg Square / Chancery Square, welfare checks, all clear, then full sweep:
Full sweep of Chancery Square / Freyberg Square complete, no issues to report. Standing by for presence and nearby response calls.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a male sleeping outside; assistance requested to move him along.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; male POI had already left. Standing by for presence, watching for issues or vagrants.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant outside failing to comply with the manager's request to leave.
Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; advised the male vagrant to move away from the premises. He complied and moved along. Standing by.
Leaving standby; heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone.
Arrived at HQ, charging Ops Phone.
Standing by at HQ awaiting Night Shift for handover.
Afternoon shift concluded, handover to Night Shift. All Auror reports regarding today's incidents have been processed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Night shift geared up, heading out to patrol.
On standby outside Bar101 showing presence, awaiting guard's arrival.
Guard arrived; on standby showing security presence.
Bar101 quiet at the moment; Elliott Street / Darby Street all clear, no issues. Heading over to Queen Street.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's, Localito, Avachi, 77 Convenience Store, no issues. Patrolling upper Queen.
Upper Queen Street all clear, no issues; patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, no nearby calls. Heading back down Queen Street.
Check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu / The Hour Glass, all clear, no issues.
Vulcan Lane all clear, no issues to report.
Queen Street has road works happening near the Cartier store.
Full sweep Imperial Lane, all clear, no issues.
Group of minors outside the Q Convenience Store; on standby showing security presence.
All clear outside the convenience store, no issues to report.
Welfare check Britomart McDonald's; asked by staff to remove a group of minors hanging around inside.
Removed the group from the premises, no further issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete, all clear; welfare checks with city guards guarding Pop's Pinball, no issues.
Full sweep Quay Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare checks with guards at AAS / Providor / Danny's and marina guards, no issues to report.
Patrolling back along Quay Street towards groups in the area; on standby around the wharf showing presence.
A fight broke out on Quay Street; we intervened, though a few punches had already been thrown between them.
Separated the two parties, no further issues.
Welfare check Albert Street Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Welfare check 77 Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Full sweep Victoria Street, all clear, no issues to report.
On standby at Bar101 showing security presence.
Bar101 closed now; on standby showing presence until cleared.
Elliott Street / Darby Street / Wilson Carpark all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's, no issues to report. Heading back to HQ for toilet breaks and refreshments.
On standby at HQ charging Ops Phone (8%), responding to any calls.
Check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu / The Hour Glass, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Britomart McDonald's / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Check-in Chancery Square / Freyberg / Kitchener Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Check-in corner of Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wellesley Street, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Federal Street; check-in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues.
Swept the rest of Albert Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Quay Street, all clear, no issues. Heading back up Queen Street for full sweep.
Queen Street full sweep complete; heading back to HQ to await Morning Shift for changeover.
